execute_one_child_turn.designNote: This node executes one admitted native child turn. The reviewed surface union is 12 base Responses tools, humanagent_turn_end, three conditional parent child controls and humanagent_child_deliver in a child run. The union is not enabled on every request, and this binding does not claim live Provider exposure.

collect_turn_facts.designNote: Collect current-turn raw tool results, accepted evidence references, child adoption or non-selection decisions, failures, unresolved operations and recovery material. Historical typed ToolExecutionFact validation remains relevant evidence, but it is not a file.search-only gate and this graph does not claim that attachment is implemented.

derive_semantic_candidate.designNote: Only an accepted standard end can produce the four-part goal/actions/result/expectedNextStep candidate. A failure before that end returns no standard semantic candidate and carries the original cause; it must not synthesize a summary. When a candidate exists, Runtime still verifies scope, evidence references, and child adoption as before. Wire status is partial: captured two-turn/three-turn POST cases changed from RED 2/2 to GREEN 2/2 for existing checkpointId, committedAt, description and top-level evidenceRefs in v1. The v2 and child-run encoder branches are source-fixed but runtime UNVERIFIED. AdoptedChildSemanticContext/AdoptedChildSemanticDelivery have no evidenceRefs field; RefinedChildSemanticDelivery is a different existing type, no new child field was added, and the historical adopted-child evidenceRefs gap remains. Overall goal is not complete.

save_checkpoint_boundary.designNote: With a standard candidate, the checkpoint boundary commits the accepted four-part semantic summary, runtime-verified evidence references and adopted child refined deliveries through the existing checkpoint/control owner. Without an accepted standard end, it commits no standard checkpoint, closure, history publication, durable success receipt, next-turn or reentry state. The same failure boundary may reuse packages/app/src/ui-runtime/native-execution.ts prepareCapture for producer drain and actual settlement, then packages/app/src/ui-runtime/execution-composition.ts closeOwnedProvider for physical close. The lease-owned route uses packages/app/src/ui-runtime/prepared-execution-stop.ts closePreparationProvider; its durable resource-acquired and resource-closed facts bind the exact parent operation. The driver-owned CLI route has no prepared-stop facts: it forwards the exact checked closed, non-retained evidenceRefs from the same Runtime closeForExecution result to that parent operation's final execution.terminal event as observation only, not recovery control or next-turn eligibility. Capture or close failure remains a typed recovery fact. A local checkpointAndClosureCommitted fact is not full five-phase readiness; the five-phase coordinator decides separately.

project_success_disposition.designNote: This projection is inactive when the current turn failed before an accepted standard end. A released parent lifecycle, blocked task, or closed resource cannot activate success.

recovery_hold.designNote: Recovery hold preserves the original failure plus actual capture, settlement, and owned Provider close results. It may represent a physically closed resource without converting the failed turn to a successful standard closure. The Runtime standard-turn catch keeps the primary error distinct from a later cleanup error and attaches only a real different cleanup failure.

assess_turn_disposition.designNote: UI projection replay is observation evidence only and is not authoritative Organ Journal state or recovery proof.
